ownerConfirmation.scope: Owner-confirmed genuine same-browser recovery callback and subsequent sign-in; not observed through a connected browser by the agent.

limitations: The timestamp comparison does not independently corroborate a new password login after the latest recovery request; the owner-reported browser result is recorded separately.
Original cross-browser signup callback failure is retained in the audit history.
A fresh same-browser signup-confirmation callback was not separately retested.
No passwords, tokens, confirmation links or browser session were exported.
